name: skillkit
description: Personal, open-source Claude Code plugins for .NET and Angular development, built on the AIDD framework.

plugins.name: skillkit-tdd
plugins.description: Strict TDD on top of AIDD: RED/GREEN/REFACTOR skill, test-writer agent, and a commit gate that requires a recent green test run

plugins.name: skillkit-dotnet
plugins.description: Backend .NET on top of AIDD: hexagonal + graded DDD conventions, architecture / C# reviews, unit-test skill, backend implementer and reviewer agents

plugins.name: skillkit-angular
plugins.description: Frontend Angular on top of AIDD: modern conventions, pedagogical review and explainer, unit-test skill, frontend implementer and reviewer agents

plugins.name: skillkit-bodyguard
plugins.description: Guard rail mod: asks for confirmation before rm -f/-r, git push --force, git reset --hard and DROP TABLE

plugins.name: skillkit-gauge
plugins.description: Gauge mod: context, 5-hour limit and week above the prompt, colored by urgency, plus a /gauge pane

plugins.name: skillkit-ctx
plugins.description: Context weight mod: /ctx pane showing what weighs on the context and what each turn adds

plugins.name: skillkit-tools
plugins.description: Claude Code tooling: plugin-audit and marketplace-add
